name: Modal
product: Modal provides cloud infrastructure for compute-intensive AI workloads, including GPU inference and sandboxes.
opportunity: Resolve people, workspaces and organizations into a trustworthy account graph.
hypothesis: When a researcher, workspace and company are not connected, usage signals can be hard to turn into an accurate owner or relevant conversation. A source-aware identity layer could make that context usable.
automations: Suggest company matches with source and confidence attached.
Surface material workload changes without treating them as buying intent automatically.
roadmap: Map user, workspace and account sources; define identity and lineage rules.
Prototype a reviewed organization graph with deduplication and freshness checks.
Add workload signals and reconcile reporting with the data and GTM teams.
fit: The Hey Sammy pipeline combines structured extraction, validation, deduplication and resumable jobs; the local partnership CRM retains contact provenance.
